# What each ministry still needs to tell us

<!-- Generated by tools/build-ministries.mjs from data/ministries.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every parish ministry now has a page of its own. Most of those pages are
mostly empty, and deliberately so: this draft states nothing about a ministry
that nobody has confirmed, so a page says it is waiting rather than filling
the space with something plausible.

Below is what each ministry would need to supply to fill its page. None of it
is a form — a paragraph in reply, or five minutes at coffee hour, is enough.

Generated from `data/ministries.json`, last updated 2026-08-13.

## A note on names and photographs

Twenty-one parishioners are named in this draft, and the Parish Council
approved that. The approval covers names and offices only — no personal
email address, telephone number, photograph or biography. See
`data/parish-facts.json` → `_rosterPermission`.

So 3 of the 8 ministry pages name nobody at all:
JOY, AHEPA, Choir. If those ministries have a lead who is
willing to be named, that is the single most useful thing to send back.

Every photograph on every ministry page is an empty frame with a caption
describing what it would show. A photograph can replace a frame as soon as
somebody records who is in it and that they agreed to appear.
